name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
description: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment: telescopic camera imaging the surface at about 25 to 30 cm per pixel. Source of the Jezero orthomosaic and of the 1 m terrain model used for routes.

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
description: Context Camera: black-and-white images at about 6 m per pixel covering almost all of Mars. Base map of the crater.

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
description: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars: visible and infrared spectra that map minerals from orbit, such as the olivine and carbonates of Jezero.

name: Mars Odyssey
description: Thermal Emission Imaging System: infrared images at about 100 m per pixel that separate rock, dust and sand by how they heat up and cool down.

name: Mars Global Surveyor
description: Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter: laser measurements of surface height that form the global topography of Mars, at about 463 m per pixel.

name: Mars 2020 (Perseverance)
description: Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer: the rover's weather sensors at Jezero (temperature, pressure, wind, humidity and dust).
